reforms.description: The creation of special zones for structural reform allows local authorities to propose regulatory changes tailored to their regions, promoting business development and innovation through enhanced collaboration between businesses and academia. Additionally, minimum required capital for start-ups has been reduced to 1 yen if certain conditions are satisfied, aiming to encourage more start-ups and venture businesses. Reforms to urban zoning regulations have also been implemented to encourage more efficient use of land and ease requirements for starting new companies, promoting entrepreneurship.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These reforms are designed to enhance business development and entrepreneurship, which are expected to raise productivity and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The reforms have been implemented as part of the government's strategy to promote innovation and entrepreneurship.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent significant structural changes aimed at fostering innovation and entrepreneurship.
reforms.source_quote: In particular, urban zoning regulations have been reformed to encourage more efficient use of land, while requirements for starting new companies have been eased to promote entrepreneurship.

reforms.description: The government has set an objective of doubling the stock of foreign direct investment (FDI) in Japan over a five-year period, drawing up an action plan with 74 items to improve the investment climate.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This initiative aims to enhance the investment climate, which is expected to attract more foreign investment and stimulate economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The action plan has been implemented to achieve the objective of doubling FDI.
reforms.importance_rationale: The initiative represents a significant policy change aimed at improving the investment climate in Japan.
reforms.source_quote: The government has set an objective of doubling the stock of FDI in Japan over a five-year period. To meet that goal, it has drawn up an action plan that covers 74 items.

reforms.description: The FY2003 budget introduced tax credits for investment in R&D and information and communication facilities, aiming to promote growth by increasing incentives for investment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The tax credits are designed to incentivize private sector investment in R&D, which is expected to enhance innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The tax credits have been implemented as part of the FY2003 budget.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, the introduction of tax credits is a narrower reform compared to broader structural changes.
reforms.source_quote: The tax reductions in FY2003 include an introduction of tax credits for investment in R&D and information and communication facilities.

reforms.description: The Strategic Council on Intellectual Property has adopted a comprehensive programme to promote the creation of intellectual property (IP) by providing more incentives to universities and strengthening the protection of IP rights.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The programme aims to enhance the creation and protection of IP, which is crucial for fostering innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The programme has been adopted and is in effect.
reforms.importance_rationale: The programme is significant but more focused compared to broader reforms.
reforms.source_quote: The Strategic Council on Intellectual Property has adopted a comprehensive programme to promote the creation of intellectual property (IP) through giving more incentives to universities, strengthening the protection of IP rights and accelerating the process of approving patent licences.
